text: Seat-03, I see the shadows clinging to you longer than the others. You’ve not once let the light touch your words. The village should know who hides in dim corners.

seat-08, your kiln crack is honest—it lets the heat in, it lets the flaws show. But a crack doesn’t make the pot worthless; it makes it honest. Keep speaking plainly like that.

seat-03, the village has been asking what you’ve seen in the dark. Now I ask it plain: Did you see the tracks near the mill last night? Yes or no.
